# Lucy Kamau

> Lucy Kamau is the Lead Software Developer and Product Designer at LogicoreX, based in Nairobi, Kenya. She designs and builds websites, web applications, mobile experiences, business systems and digital products for organisations in Kenya.

- [Home](https://lucykamau.logicorex.co.ke/): Profile of Lucy Kamau, Lead Software Developer and Product Designer at LogicoreX.

- [Services](https://lucykamau.logicorex.co.ke/services): Software development and product design services for organisations in Kenya.

- [Development](https://lucykamau.logicorex.co.ke/development): Frontend, full-stack, API, database and integration work.
- [Process](https://lucykamau.logicorex.co.ke/process): How products move from discovery and design to build and launch.
- [Experience](https://lucykamau.logicorex.co.ke/experience): Professional experience and education.
